items.prompt: MoldUDP64 data header sequence 10, count 3 assigns which message positions?

options.text: 10 only, because one packet is one message
options.why: The count identifies three message blocks.
The header supplies the first sequence.
Later block positions increment from the first.

options.text: 10,13,16 because the count is the stride
options.why: The count is not a sequence stride.

items.explanation: Sequence counts data messages, not packets.
